description: Live check of ANY online store, tracked by Neoavis or not: can an AI shopping agent read it without clicking? Reads the UCP checkout profile (/.well-known/ucp), structured product data, robots.txt access for shopping agents, llms.txt and sitemap, in a few seconds. Use it when the user wants to buy from a store that consulter_marchand does not know, or wants to know if their own store is ready for AI agents. For a store Neoavis already tested, consulter_marchand gives the full purchase test. Returns: points (out of 15), verdict (pret, partiel or pas_pret), criteres_reussis, neoavis (score out of 100 and page when tracked), resume (one sentence to quote), detail_gratuit_humain (page with the per-criterion detail for a human) and suites_payantes (x402 URLs, USDC on Base, no account: per-criterion live check, and a full purchase test). Free: 10 checks per hour per address. Unreadable domain or unreachable site: error result.

site.description: Domain or URL of any online store, for example exemple-boutique.fr.
